notes: No Clarity site (elections.json 404). The county Elections page posts scanned Konica Minolta PDFs. Every unofficial result file opened was uploaded the morning after election day: 2024 general 'Unofficial General Election Results' (Electionware Summary Results Report, county totals, footer read as 'Election Summary - 11/05/2024 11:48 PM', scanned Nov 6 15:07 UTC, Last-Modified Wed, 06 Nov 2024 15:28:58 GMT); 2026 primary 'Unofficial Results' (scanned Mar 4 15:36 UTC, Last-Modified Wed, 04 Mar 2026 15:27:00 GMT) with 'Republican Precinct Results' scanned Apr 6 2026 (Last-Modified Mon, 06 Apr 2026 15:41:29 GMT); 2026 runoff 'Unofficial Results' and 'Unofficial Results Precinct' (scanned 9:41 and 9:42 PM CDT May 26, Last-Modified Wed, 27 May 2026 15:26:46 and 15:27:20 GMT = 10:26 to 10:27 AM CDT May 27). The 2024 general precinct file listed is 'Official Results by Precinct' (not opened). So no result file, county-level or precinct-level, was online during election night for any target election, and precinct numbers came after election night. HTML pages send no Last-Modified header; PDF Last-Modified values differ per file and match scan dates, so they are taken as upload times. The 2026 primary unofficial PDF was not checked page by page for a precinct breakdown, but it was uploaded after election night either way. Check 3 not needed. Rule 43 applied 2026-10-02 (normalize-2): 2024_general LATER kept, county_totals_first_seen 2024-11-05 23:40 CT; 2026_primary LATER kept, county_totals_first_seen 2026-03-03 21:24 CT; 2026_runoff LATER kept, county_totals_first_seen 2026-05-26 20:18 CT. Footer times re-read from the cached copies at 200 dpi.
